description: A small toy-brick robot: legs, blue body, grey arms, white head, eyes and a red top brick. A finished model of 10 toy bricks in one block: the brick list is fixed, so nothing needs writing out; it is the motion_bricks canvas with that list filled in, and every motion_bricks setting that does not name bricks works here the same way. Bricks drop into place in build order as p goes 0 to 1 and the model turns with the second dial (--s). Standalone it shows the finished model. Known limit, each brick canvas holds two WebGL contexts and a page allows about 16, so keep to about 7 brick canvases per page. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the LEGO Group.
